title: Numbered constant
description: One row of a name/value table a page prints (Flag | Value | Description, Return code | Hexadecimal | Decimal, Symbolic constant | Value (Hex), Control code | Value, Message identifier | Value, Element | Hex code, HRESULT Name | Value, Value | Weight for the font-weight constants, and the same shapes). name and value are the cells as printed; a row is kept only when the name cell is one identifier and the value cell is one number. A column the page heads as hexadecimal but fills with digits and no 0x prefix is stored as those digits -- the prefix is not added. decimal is set only when a decimal column prints a decimal beside the value -- a hexadecimal is never converted. headers are the header files that same page states, and only those. entity is the page's entity only when the constant's own name is that entity; a flag listed on a function's page is not that function. Never inferred: a constant the page does not number has no record. A correspondence table (character set beside a code page, virtual key beside a scan code, locale beside an LCID) is not a constant row.
